evidence.label: NHTSA Recall 83V107 - Front Brake Hydraulic Crossover Pipe

after.title: Fender-Skirt Contact Can Wear Through a Front Brake Pipe (Recall 83V107)
after.description: NHTSA Recall 83V107 covers certain 1983-1984 Chevrolet Blazer four-wheel-drive vehicles. Contact and vibration from the right-front fender skirt can wear through the hydraulic crossover pipe, leak brake fluid, remove front braking and increase stopping distance.
after.solution: Check the VIN for recall completion. The campaign corrects fender-skirt clearance and installs a replacement crossover pipe when the position or clearance is wrong.
symptoms: Brake-fluid leak at the right-front crossover pipe
affectedSystems: front brake hydraulic crossover pipe and right-front fender skirt

evidence.label: NHTSA Recall 93V119 - Salt-Corrosion Front Brake Rotors

after.title: Salt Corrosion Can Separate Front Brake-Rotor Sections (Recall 93V119)
after.description: NHTSA Recall 93V119 covers certain 1988-1994 Chevrolet Blazer vehicles identified by specified VIN characters and sold or registered in listed salt-belt states. Road-salt corrosion can separate the stamped center and cast outer rotor sections, reducing braking at the affected wheel.
after.solution: Check the VIN and geographic eligibility. The recall replaces the front brake rotors with corrosion-protected rotors; ordinary worn brake linings remain a maintenance item.
symptoms: Severe corrosion at the front rotor section joint
Loss of braking at an affected wheel
Increased stopping distance or reduced control
